title: Return an average
prompt: Write `average`, which returns the average of two whole numbers with decimals, so average(1, 2) is 1.5. `solve` returns average(a, b).
starter:
func solve(a, b) -> float:
	return (a + b) / 2
hints: Dividing two ints drops the decimals; divide by a float.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.
